what: Every run of the peripheral-crowding checks. Bounds file unchanged since 679f718. Status: NOT LANDED; two committed criteria conflict for this design.

runs.check: node tests, first run (box-pyramid mean, plain displaced detail)
failures: fovea test: my own precondition asked for over 1000 fovea pixels; there are 800 at 200 x 125 (the criterion itself, deviation 0, held)
local mean: worst change 0.076 against 0.02 (mean 0.005, p90 0.012); worst samples beside the lit window

runs.check: design iterations on the street frame (worst local-mean change, sampled periphery)
runs.result: contrast-normalised detail 0.056; centred variable box instead of the pyramid 0.091; plus one mean-matching step 0.056; three steps 0.041; plus moving detail only between places of similar local mean (tolerance 0.04) 0.021

runs.check: sweep of the similarity tolerance on the test frame and three held-out frames (day; gaze left; edges plate)
runs.result: worst local-mean change and peripheral detail correlation per frame
runs.finding: No setting meets both committed criteria (worst local-mean change at most 0.02 and detail correlation at most 0.3) across frames. Scrambling an edge necessarily shifts the mean of any box that straddles it, so a worst-case bound of 0.02 at every sampled pixel conflicts with rearranging detail near strong edges. On average the mean holds (0.0025 to 0.006).

decision: Not landed. The bounds stay as committed. Options for the coordinator: keep crowding out of this round; or fix a new criterion (for example a percentile of the local-mean change) in a new, dated bounds file before any new run, recorded as a re-specification after this failure, not as a pass.
